name: Tea stall and eatery
intro: If regular customers run a tab at your tea stall, tiffin centre or small eatery, BolCash helps you note it down and clear it when they pay.

uses.title: Customer tabs
uses.body: Note down each regular customer's tab. Mark it when they pay.

uses.title: Supplier dues
uses.body: Keep track of what you owe your milk, gas and grocery suppliers, and note it when you pay.

uses.title: Daily cash
uses.body: Record the money that comes in and goes out each day.
